title.native: 学戦都市アスタリスク

description:
Invertia (meteor storm)… an unprecedented disaster that struck the world during the 20th century.

Because of this disaster, numerous cities around the world were destroyed. However, within the meteor, an unknown element called mana (the all-encompassing element), was discovered, which allowed human technology to make rapid strides.

This also gave rise to a new species of human born with unique skills – the Star Pulse Generation (Genestella).

The setting for the world’s greatest comprehensive battle spectacle, the Festas (Star Warrior Festivals), is an academy city above the water surrounded by six academies called Rikka also commonly known as Asterisk. Having transferred into Seidoukan Academy in order to fulfill his own wish, scholarship student Ayato Amagiri swears he too will fight in this city.

Burning souls race…

The curtain rises on this school battle spectacle!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

name.native: ユリス＝アレクシア・フォン・リースフェルト

node.description:
Julis is the fifth ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and is Lieseltania's First Princess. Her full name is Julis-Alexia Marie Florentia Renate von Riessfelt. She wields a rapier-type lux called Aspera Spina which she uses during the Phoenix tournament and bears the image of a flower for her power - control over flames.

She warms to [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058/Amagiri-Ayato), unlike the other students with whom she is distant. She starts to like Ayato and often find herself arguing with [Saya](https://anilist.co/character/89060/Sasamiya-Saya) and [Kirin](https://anilist.co/character/89059/Toudou-Kirin) and even [Claudia](https://anilist.co/character/89061/Enfield-Claudia) for his attention.

He transfers to Seidoukan Academy to investigate his sister's disappearance and to figure out what he is supposed to do (~!he later says that it is to protect Julis!~).
Ayato sports a friendly, polite, and helpful personality with a penchant for ending up in awkward situations. He is indiscriminate as to who he is being friendly to and is helpful to a fault, as well as being a bit naive. However, underneath the soft facade lies a person with an indomitable will who always tries to do the right thing, regardless of the potential trouble that he will get himself into.

Kirin is the top-ranking student of Seidoukan Academy. She is a shy and quiet girl who becomes the academy's top student as a 13 year-old and has not lost to anyone until Ayato challenges her a second time. She does not have a personal lux but rather carries a katana (Senbakiri) around as a weapon which often makes her greatly marveled by others as she tops the former No. 1 spot just by using a katana.

Saya is Ayato's childhood friend. She moved abroad six years ago due to her father's career. She seems to be an air-headed stoic who has trouble waking up in the morning and is directionally-challenged. She uses a 38th generation Lux grenade launcher Helnekrom but later switches to a type 41 Gleaming Form - twin particle guns Waidenholt and Type 34 wave Motion heavy artillery Ark Van Ders for the Phoenix. Like Kirin, she enters the Phoenix for her father's sake.

name.native: クローディア・エンフィールド

node.description: Claudia is the second highest ranking student of Seidoukan Academy and its Student Council President. She recommended [Ayato](https://anilist.co/character/89058)'s transfer to the academy. She has held the position of President since junior high.

Jie Long's Rank #1 as well as its student council president. Wielder of the most formidable combat skills in all of Asterisk even though she is still nine years old, and she has been crowned “the most powerful.” Has inherited Jie Long’s fabled alias, Divine Revelations.

name.native: プリシラ・ウルサイス

node.description: She is Irene's younger sister. She cares deeply for her sister, Irene, and is a lot more level-headed than her.

name.native: イレーネ・ウルサイス

node.description: Rank 3 of Rewolf Black Institute. She wields the Gravisheath~!, until Ayato destroys it in their battle,!~ which influenced her fanged teeth allowing her to suck blood to power her ogre lux. She puts her sister Priscilla above all else.
The student council secretary of Rewolf Black Institute. She has absolutely no combat capabilities. She isn't the brightest and can be considered a klutz.

name.native: ディルク・ エーベルヴァイン

node.description: The student council president of Rewolf Black Institute. A base-line human whose unprecedented rise to top of a battle school for superhumans is due to his ability to manipulate others behind the scenes.
A student from Arlequint Academy and member of Ferrovious (Lions Faction). She is indebted to Ernesta and the two share a close relationship.

name.native: エルネスタ・キューネ

node.description: A student from Arlequint Academy and leader of Pygmalion (Sculptor Faction). A genius at making puppets, she wants AIs to be treated as equal to humans and sees AR-D and RM-C as her children.

Ayato's older sister. She is the one that taught Ayato the family fighting style. She entered school five years prior to Ayato's entrance to Seidoukan Academy but disappeared half a year later. She also participated in the unofficial underground Eclipse tournament. She once wielded the Ser-Versta; however, all records of her and including those pertaining to Lux have been erased.
He is Ayato's roommate. Well known as a member of the academy's newspaper club, he also possesses a variety of information which he often lends to Ayato when needed.
